name: Shirudaku Settai Okawari Nihaime ~Inochi Mijikashi, Okaseyo Otome! Hen~
original_name: 汁だく接待 おかわり二杯目 ～命短し、犯せよ乙女!編～
source:
Nero, who has been a wanted for several years, sneaks into girls high school as a janitor... just to rape girls. However, the school has secrets that even Nero doesn't know. A big rape show now begins....
